unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?

sections.title: Reading — A Day in the Life of Gordon Higgins

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in the gaps with the verbs in the list in the correct form. Some of the verbs can be used more than once.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'g'ri shaklda to'ldiring. Ba'zi fe'llar bir necha marta ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'LLAR RO'YXATI (8 ta):
  go, say, meet, get up, work, listen, have, read

BO'SHLIQLAR — 15 ta. Demak ba'zi fe'llar TAKRORLANADI:
  have → 4 marta (shower, breakfast, lunch, dinner)
  go   → 5 marta (to his study, back, out, to bed, fishing)
  qolganlari 1 martadan

BARCHA FE'LLAR 3-SHAXS BIRLIKDA (Gordon / He):
  get up → gets up,  have → has,  go → goes,
  work → works,      meet → meets, listen → listens,
  read → reads,      say → says

GORDON — YOZUVCHI (author/writer).
U 'early bird' — soat 5 da turadi va 10 da yotadi.
'Brakers' va 'The Sword' — uning kitoblari.

DIQQAT — 'have' ning ko'p ma'nosi:
  have a shower  — dush qabul qilmoq
  have breakfast — nonushta qilmoq
  have lunch     — tushlik qilmoq
  have dinner    — kechki ovqat qilmoq

lines.textEn: Gordon Higgins, the author of 'Brakers' and 'The Sword' 1) ____ at five o'clock every morning ...
lines.whyUz: 'get up' → 'gets up'. 'the author OF' — predlog shart.

lines.textEn: Gordon usually 7) ____ back to his study to work from one till five, ...
... but sometimes he 8) ____ his publisher to talk about his new books.
He always 9) ____ to the news on the radio at five, ...
lines.whyUz: 'listen TO' → 'listens to'. RAVISH: 'always'. 'on the radio' — predlog.

lines.textEn: After dinner, he usually 11) ____ a book, ...
... but sometimes he 12) ____ out with his friends.
He usually 13) ____ to bed at ten o'clock.
In his free time, Gordon often 14) ____ fishing or sailing on the lake near his house.
lines.whyUz: 'go fishing / go sailing' → 'goes'. RAVISH: 'often'. 'sail' = yelkanli qayiqda suzmoq.

lines.textEn: Gordon likes being a writer. "I am very happy with my life at the moment," he 15) ____ .
"Interesting job, lots of money ... yes, it is perfect!"
lines.uz: 'Qiziqarli ish, ko'p pul... ha, bu mukammal!'

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda matnga ZID ma'lumot bor.
Xato SOAT, FE'L yoki RAVISHDA bo'lishi mumkin —
shuning uchun matnni juda diqqat bilan solishtiring.

items.textEn: 1  Gordon gets up at nine o'clock.
items.answer: Gordon gets up at five o'clock.
items.whyUz: SOAT xato. Matnda: 'at five o'clock every morning'.

items.textEn: 2  He sleeps from six till twelve.
items.answer: He works from six till twelve.
items.whyUz: FE'L xato. Matnda: 'works from six till twelve'. U uxlamaydi — ishlaydi!

items.textEn: 3  He always meets his publisher in the afternoon.
items.answer: He sometimes meets his publisher in the afternoon.
items.whyUz: RAVISH xato. Matnda: 'SOMETIMES he meets his publisher'.

items.textEn: 4  He always watches the news on TV at five.
items.answer: He always listens to the news on the radio at five.
items.whyUz: IKKI xato: fe'l ('watches' emas 'listens to') va vosita ('TV' emas 'the radio').

items.textEn: 5  After dinner, he usually writes a book.
items.answer: After dinner, he usually reads a book.
items.whyUz: FE'L xato. Matnda: 'reads a book'. U yozuvchi, lekin kechqurun O'QIYDI.

items.textEn: 6  He usually goes to bed at twelve o'clock.
items.answer: He usually goes to bed at ten o'clock.

items.textEn: 7  He's very stressed with his life at the moment.
items.answer: He's very happy with his life at the moment.
items.whyUz: SIFAT xato. Matnda: 'I am very HAPPY with my life at the moment'.

sections.title: Writing — an article about Kyle Thompson

exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalni o'rganing — maqola shu asosda yoziladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — Kayl Tompsonning kuni.
Qisqa yozuvlarni TO'LIQ GAPGA aylantirasiz.

JADVALDAN GAPGA MISOL:
  '8am - get up & have breakfast'
  → He gets up and has breakfast at eight o'clock.

  '10:30am - 12:30pm - give tennis lessons to children'
  → From half past ten till half past twelve, he gives
    tennis lessons to children.

DIQQAT — jadvalda '&' belgisi, gapda 'and' yoziladi.

sentences.en: NAME: Kyle Thompson — JOB: tennis coach
sentences.uz: Ismi: Kayl Tompson — Kasbi: tennis murabbiyi

sentences.en: IN THE MORNING: 8am - get up & have breakfast
IN THE EVENING: 5pm - 6:30pm - play with children / help wife cook dinner
sentences.uz: Kechqurun: 17:00–18:30 — bolalari bilan o'ynaydi / xotiniga ovqat pishirishda yordam beradi
sentences.noteUz: 'help somebody DO something' — 'to' KERAK EMAS: help wife COOK.
'watch TV' — artikl yo'q. 'listen TO music' — 'to' shart.
Kayl — 'night owl' emas, lekin Gordon'dan kechroq yotadi.

sentences.en: IN HIS FREE TIME: go to tennis matches / play the guitar
sentences.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida: tennis musobaqalariga boradi / gitara chaladi
sentences.noteUz:
'play THE guitar' — musiqa asbobi bilan 'the' SHART.
Lekin 'play tennis' — sport bilan 'the' YO'Q.

sentences.en: FEELINGS: feel very satisfied — "It's a great way to keep fit and earn a living at the same time!"
sentences.uz: His-tuyg'ulari: juda mamnun — 'Bu bir vaqtning o'zida sog'lom bo'lish va pul topishning ajoyib yo'li!'
sentences.noteUz:
'keep fit' = sog'lom, sport shaklida bo'lmoq.
'earn a living' = tirikchilik qilmoq.
'at the same time' = bir vaqtning o'zida.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table below and use the notes to write an article about Kyle Thompson's daily routine.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing va qaydlardan foydalanib, Kayl Tompsonning kundalik tartibi haqida maqola yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILISHI (Coursebook 34-betdagi Bob Ellis matni kabi):

  Para 1: ism, kasb, ishga munosabat
  Para 2: ertalab
  Para 3: kunduzi va kechqurun
  Para 4: bo'sh vaqti va his-tuyg'ulari

KERAKLI TILDAN FOYDALANING:
  • Present Simple (3-shaxs -s)
  • vaqt predloglari: AT + soat, IN THE + kun qismi
  • FROM ... TILL/TO ... — davomiylik
  • takrorlanish ravishlari

24 SOATLIKNI 12 SOATLIKKA aylantiring:
  8am    → eight o'clock in the morning
  12:30pm → half past twelve
  4:30pm  → half past four in the afternoon
  6:30pm  → half past six in the evening
  11pm    → eleven o'clock at night

structure.modelEn: Kyle Thompson is a tennis coach.
He gets up and has breakfast at eight o'clock in the morning.
At half past eight, he goes to the gym and at half past nine he has a shower.
He goes to the tennis club at ten o'clock.
From half past ten till half past twelve, he gives tennis lessons to children.
He has lunch at half past twelve.
From one o'clock till half past four, he gives tennis lessons to adults.
He goes home at half past four.
From five o'clock till half past six, he plays with his children and helps his wife cook dinner.

structure.headingUz: Para 3 — kechki ovqat va dam olish
structure.modelEn: He has dinner at half past six. From seven o'clock till eleven o'clock, he watches TV or listens to music.
He goes to bed at eleven o'clock at night.
In his free time, Kyle goes to tennis matches and plays the guitar.
He feels very satisfied with his job. "It's a great way to keep fit and earn a living at the same time!" he says.
structure.noteUz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq bilan tugatish — Bob Ellis matni kabi.

modelAnswers: Kyle Thompson is a tennis coach.

In the morning, he gets up and has breakfast at eight o'clock. At half past eight, he goes to the gym and at half past nine he has a shower. He goes to the tennis club at ten o'clock and from half past ten till half past twelve, he gives tennis lessons to children.
In the afternoon, he has lunch at half past twelve. From one o'clock till half past four, he gives tennis lessons to adults, and then he goes home.
In the evening, he plays with his children and helps his wife cook dinner. He has dinner at half past six, then he watches TV or listens to music until eleven o'clock, when he goes to bed.
In his free time, Kyle goes to tennis matches and plays the guitar. He feels very satisfied with his job. "It's a great way to keep fit and earn a living at the same time!" he says.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 23-bet — yozuvchi, sport va turg'un iboralar.

groups.explanationUz: Musiqa asbobi bilan 'the' SHART, sport bilan YO'Q. Bu farq juda muhim.
Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l 'to' SIZ keladi.

items.note: 'help her to cook' ham to'g'ri, lekin kamroq

items.derived: a great way TO keep fit

groups.explanationUz: Yozilishi va o'qilishi mos kelmaydigan fe'l.

patterns.formula: ISM, the author OF + kitob, + fe'l+S + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Gordon Higgins, the author of 'Brakers' and 'The Sword', gets up at five o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Brakers' va 'The Sword' muallifi Gordon Higgins soat beshda turadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qo'shimcha ma'lumot ikki vergul orasida beriladi.
'the author OF' — predlog shart.

patterns.formula: EGA + fe'l+S + FROM + vaqt + TILL + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: He works from six till twelve. From half past ten till half past twelve, he gives tennis lessons.
patterns.exampleUz: U oltidan o'n ikkigacha ishlaydi. O'n yarimdan o'n ikki yarimgacha tennis darsi beradi.

patterns.exampleEn: He always listens to the news. He usually reads a book. Sometimes he goes out with his friends.
patterns.exampleUz: U doim yangiliklarni tinglaydi. Odatda kitob o'qiydi. Ba'zan do'stlari bilan chiqadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ravish fe'ldan oldin. 'Sometimes' gap boshida ham kelishi mumkin.

patterns.exampleEn: He helps his wife cook dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: U xotiniga ovqat pishirishda yordam beradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'help + odam + fe'l' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.
'want to', 'like to' bilan solishtiring — ularda 'to' bor.

patterns.formula: In his free time, EGA + fe'l+S + ... and plays THE + asbob.
patterns.exampleEn: In his free time, Kyle goes to tennis matches and plays the guitar.
patterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida Kayl tennis musobaqalariga boradi va gitara chaladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Musiqa asbobi bilan 'the' SHART: play THE guitar.
Sport bilan esa YO'Q: play tennis.

patterns.formula: "...," he says. / He feels very satisfied WITH + narsa.
patterns.exampleEn: "It's a great way to keep fit and earn a living at the same time!" he says.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Bu bir vaqtning o'zida sog'lom bo'lish va pul topishning ajoyib yo'li!' — deydi u.
patterns.explanationUz:
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutqdan keyin 'he says'.
'says' /sez/ deb o'qiladi.
